name: Ulven Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a primary residence with a brown roof and additional detached structures with matching roofs|A paved loop driveway provides access from a public road and wraps the main house|A swimming pool and surrounding hardscape sit beside the residence|Mature trees occupy much of the lot|A waterway runs along one edge of the property|Open grass extends between the developed area and the waterway.

alpha.desc: The front approach shows a paved drive entering from the public road, dense mature trees, and the main house set back on the lot|Additional roofed structures sit along the drive|A large paved circulation area is visible near the house|Trees screen much of the frontage from the road.

bravo.desc: The left side of the property is dominated by dense mature trees|The paved drive curves through the tree line toward the house|Open grass and additional tree cover continue along this side|The public road remains visible at the entrance.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows the swimming pool, rear hardscape, the main house, the detached structures and a waterway along the back edge|Open grass sits between the pool area and the water|Mature trees wrap both sides of the developed area|The loop driveway remains visible on the house side of the lot.

delta.desc: The right side of the property shows the paved loop driveway, the main house, additional structures, and the waterway along the outer edge|Mature trees line the drive and the waterway bank|Open grass occupies the ground between the house and the water.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from Silverton Rd that loops around the main house and provides turnaround space. The site is a rural residence with additional detached structures, a swimming pool, and a waterway along one boundary. Dense mature trees limit sightlines from the road and along several sides. The paved loop and open grass near the house provide staging space. Neighboring fields, orchard rows, and farm buildings occupy the surrounding area.
clarifications: Is the loop driveway the only vehicle route, or is there a second access from another road? Are there any gates on the entrance drive? Is vehicle access available to the pool area and the waterway bank? What is the purpose of each detached structure? How close is the waterway to the house for apparatus placement? Is after-hours access controlled by a gate or code?
